snippet.title: PC Engine Longplay [256] Momotarou Katsugeki
snippet.description:
http://www.longplays.org

Played by: NPI

Momotarou is known for being a series of Japanese board video games. This one however is a platform game.
There are several endings to this game depending on the difficulty mode you choose, and I chose normal mode. Here's the timings for all the endings

00:52:41 Normal mode ending
00:58:50 Easy mode ending
01:02:12 Hard mode ending
01:04:56 Gerogero mode ending (this mode is when you use the cheat for maximum power up) -
Disclaimer: Most videos by World of Longplays use SaveStates!
